title: Entry point to customize hit output
body:
It currently is impossible (or undocumented?) to not use the `hits` widget to get the hits.

However, as a fervent user of [Vue.js](https://vuejs.org/), I would appreciate the ability to, instead, use a hook to get the raw result data. Vue provides [more than enough tools](https://vuejs.org/guide/list.html) to render a list of results such as a list of hits, and this would let me have components for every result, but also insert Vue directives in the hit template, as they need to be processed by Vue to be functional.

For example, when one (like me) makes an SPA using Vue and [vue-router](https://github.com/vuejs/vue-router), if the hits must send the user to another part of the website, the attribute for the links' targets will be defined by `v-link`, not `href`. `v-link` directives, like any Vue directive, are only interpreted by Vue if the template output to DOM is done by Vue.

All this rambling just to tell you that I'd like to have (or discover) a hook to show the results using another technology than yours.
